NoPermission: You don't have permission to do that.
PlayerOnly: Only the <color=#e2a44a>reload</color> subcommand can be used from the console; the rest are per-player. Run them in-game.
HelpImport: <color=#e2a44a>/mipanel import [path]</color> — import an existing InfoPanel config.
ImportOutside: Import path must be inside the config directory.

HelpSumHelp: this help; drill into a topic
HelpBodyShow:
Shows your info panels again after hiding them.
Usage: /mipanel show
Your choice is saved across reconnects.
See also: hide
HelpBodyHide:
Hides all your info panels (nothing is deleted).
Usage: /mipanel hide
/mipanel show brings them back.
See also: show
HelpBodyClock:
Sets where your clock reads time from.
/mipanel clock game — in-game time
/mipanel clock server [offset] — server time, optional hour offset (-23..23)
Example: /mipanel clock server -2
See also: timeformat, tz
HelpBodyTimeformat:
Changes how the clock is written.
/mipanel timeformat — list available formats
/mipanel timeformat <index> — pick one
Example: /mipanel timeformat 2
See also: clock
HelpBodyTz:
Pins your clock to a named timezone (DST-correct).
/mipanel tz <zone> — e.g. America/Denver
/mipanel tz off — back to the server clock
Use IANA names in Region/City form.
See also: clock
HelpBodyPanels:
Built-in panels: Clock, Messages, Balance, Points,
Coordinates, Compass, OnlinePlayers, Sleepers,
event icons (Airdrop/Helicopter/Chinook/Cargo/Bradley/Radiation),
ServerFPS, Ping, WipeCountdown, Status.
An admin arranges them with /mipanel admin.
HelpBodyStatus:
The Status panel tints one icon to your live state:
green = safe zone, red = hostile in a safe zone,
yellow = being raided, blue = AFK, white = building-authorized.
An admin enables and places it via /mipanel admin.
See also: panels
HelpBodyTheming:
The HUD is themeable from the config:
panel background colors, text and icon colors,
the status-glow palette, and custom icon URLs.
See THEMING.md in the repo for ready-made presets.
An admin can recolor live with /mipanel admin.
HelpBodyHelp:
Shows this help, paged to fit the chat box.
/mipanel help — the command list
/mipanel help <topic> — details (e.g. /mipanel help tz)
/mipanel help <topic> <page> — turn the page
Example: /mipanel help admin
HelpBodyAdmin:
[admin] Opens the in-game editor (mouse cursor).
Toggle panels and docks, move a panel between docks,
nudge its width, and recolor its background — saved live.
Usage: /mipanel admin
Needs the moderninfopanel.admin permission.
HelpBodyReload:
[admin] Reloads the config from disk and redraws every panel.
Usage: /mipanel reload
Works from chat, F1 console, RCON, and the server console.
Needs moderninfopanel.admin (console & RCON always allowed).
HelpBodyImport:
[admin] Imports an existing InfoPanel config into MIP.
/mipanel import [path] — defaults to oxide/config/InfoPanel.json
The path must be inside the config folder.
It merges, saves, then reloads.
Needs moderninfopanel.admin.
